title: Indonesian Navy Takes Delivery of 58-Knot Missile-Capable USV
summary: The Indonesian Navy has taken delivery of its first KSR X33 Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV) from North Sea Boats. Commissioned as Patkamla Geledek, this USV is capable of 58 knots and is equipped with missile capabilities for coastal defense.

title: French Startup Arsenals Unveils Modular AUV Designed for Rapid Production
summary: French startup Arsenals unveiled a modular autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) at Euronaval 2026. This AUV design emphasizes rapid production, suggesting a focus on scalable manufacturing and potentially reduced costs for deployment.

title: Lockheed Martin Unveils Weapons Suite for Gibbs & Cox’s International Class Frigate
summary: Lockheed Martin showcased a new mid-range weapons suite for Gibbs & Cox’s International Class Frigate at Euronaval 2026. The suite integrates Vertical Launch System (VLS) cells with Joint Air-to-Ground Missile (JAGM) launchers, offering enhanced versatility.

title: Euronaval 2026: Euroatlas and EvoLogics Move Greyshark AUV into Series Production
summary: Euroatlas and EvoLogics have commenced series production of their battery-powered Greyshark Bravo Unmanned Underwater Vehicle (UUV). The first deliveries of this AUV are scheduled to take place before the end of 2026.
